title: SmartPatientCareEvent
description: Standardized event schema for SmartPatientCare system events and telemetry

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the event

event_type.description: Category or type of event (e.g., VITAL_SIGN, FALL_DETECTED, DRIP_EMPTY, VENTILATOR_ALERT)

source.description: Originating source of the event (e.g., cv_monitor, device_simulator, drip_sensor, ventilator_monitor)

parameter.description: Specific monitored parameter (e.g., heart_rate, spo2, drip_rate, fall_state)

message.description: Human-readable summary or message describing the event

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the event or alert

video_source.description: Optional URI or relative path to CCTV video evidence clip
